{{Top|leg}}
The '''Energy shield level 1''' was a basic and universal model of a [[droid shield]] that provided a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] with protection against energy damage. Unfortunately, the power drain during its use was significant, therefore, the units needed to be replaced regularly.

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 1 to be able to equip this item.
